## Change

Describe the user problem and resulting behavior. Link a related issue if available.

## Validation

List checks actually run and their results. Include screenshots for UI changes and explain any checks that could not run.

## Review checklist

- [ ] Relevant tests and documentation reflect the change.
- [ ] Generated contracts and upstream adaptation records are synchronized where applicable.
- [ ] Installation, data migration and architecture compatibility have been considered.
- [ ] No secrets, mailbox data, runtime state or generated build output are included.
